Subject: Postgraduate Thesis Writing Seminars


AUCKLAND POSTGRADUATE THESIS-WRITING SEMINARS

The last 3 seminars for Semester 1 of the Postgraduate Thesis-Writing
series will focus on the following topics:

April 9:     Drafting and Writing the Thesis and What Makes a Good
Thesis?

April 16:   The Thesis Examination and Finishing your Thesis

April 23:    Effective Oral Presentations and Getting Published

These are held on Wednesday from 12 - 2pm in QB3 (Auckland campus).

To register, contact Geraldine Tomlin: s.tjjfjv@massey.ac.nz
   or phone (09) 414 0800 extn: 9143.
